Title: Public Preview: Unified Migration Experience in Azure Database Migration Service

Body.Content:
Effortlessly migrate your MySQL workloads from on-premises, virtual machines (VMs), or other clouds to Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server with minimal downtime. The new unified migration experience in Azure Database Migration Service supports both physical and logical migration approaches. Using the physical migration approach, you can rapidly restore your source server's physical backup files on the target server, allowing you to migrate multiple terabytes of data with minimal downtime in just a few clicks. 

 

Learn more.
